**Products with no sales in the last 90 days (as of 2026-10-21): 17**

P-0102, P-0117, P-0230, P-0231, P-0388, P-0412, P-0415, P-0501, P-0577, P-0610, P-0644, P-0702, P-0719, P-0803, P-0815, P-0902, P-0990

**Issue from last week's price change:** The catalog check flagged that 22 fixed-price contract products (P-1201 through P-1222) were increased 3% on 2026-10-14. Those products were supposed to be excluded. The increase was applied by me, so this is my error. Since then, 8 orders (SO-77310 to SO-77317) were placed at the increased prices, for a total overcharge of 4,128.60.

I have not changed any prices. Recommended next steps:
1. Revert P-1201 through P-1222 to their pre-increase prices.
2. Have sales operations review the 8 affected orders and issue credits for the overcharge.

Please confirm whether I should revert the 22 prices. I'd also suggest letting Lena Ortiz know, since she requested the change.
